cohort: 1950 pediatric CNS tumor cases and 19,500 birth certificate controls
finding: The study found that Hispanic and non-Hispanic Black mothers were less likely to have children with CNS tumors, while infants born large for gestational age, preterm, or by vaginal forceps/vacuum delivery had an increased risk of CNS tumors.
mod_finding: Infants born by cesarean section had a higher risk of death compared to those delivered vaginally.
